name: detectionforge-ai
description: DetectionForge AI — From Threat Detection Logic to Multi-SIEM Queries

scripts.build: npm run build -w @detectionforge/core && npm run build -w @detectionforge/worker && npm run build -w @detectionforge/web

scripts.docs:check: npm run docs && git diff --exit-code -- docs/
